description: Most recent messages ACROSS ALL conversations, newest first — ideal for "catch me up" or "what did I miss today". Filter by direction and time window; paginate with cursor.

before.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only messages sent before this time.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: pass pagination.nextCursor from the previous page verbatim.

limit.description: Max number of messages to return (1-200). Default 50.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only messages sent at or after this time.

name: list_recent_messages
